ns2:course.label: Diffraction Physics of Matls
ns2:course.description: Quantitative treatment of the physical basis of X-ray, electron, and neutron diffraction instrumentation and use for structural characterization. Applications in materials science and condensed matter physics including structure of condensed matter, defects, phase transitions, disorder, surfaces, and interfaces. Same as PHYS 566. Prerequisite: MSE 405 or PHYS 436.
